sources.title: Associates Program Operating Agreement (updated October 15, 2025)
sources.used_for: Section 1: Special Links must use the tagged link formats. sources.title: Amazon Conditions of Use (last updated August 14, 2026)
sources.used_for: 'License and Access' section, read 2026-11-14 (arena/3036372b-zone4): the licence excludes 'any collection and use of any product listings, descriptions, or prices' and 'any use of data mining, robots, or similar data gathering and extraction tools'; it also bars using AI-generated content from the Amazon Services to develop or improve large language or multimodal models or other machine learning technology.

sources.title: FTC: Disclosures 101 for Social Media Influencers (November 2019)
sources.used_for: Read in full 2026-11-14 (arena/3036372b-zone4): the disclosure must be hard to miss and placed with the endorsement message; use simple, clear language; a material connection includes a financial relationship; do not talk about a product you have not tried; do not make claims the advertiser cannot prove.
